variables.input:
fetch logs
| filter matchesValue(dt.entity.host, "HOST-2E7EE0BF45B76576")
| filter matchesValue(log.source, "/var/node/logs/#-#-#.log")
| filter not matchesPhrase(content, "Setting up")
//| filter status == "ERROR"
| parse content, """DATA 'audio' ARRAY{DATA '_id' LD DQS:audioChannels_id DATA 'lang' LD DQS:audioChannels_lang DATA 'pid' LD word:audioChannels_pid}{0,2}:audioChannels"""
| parse content, """DATA '__v\":' LD:v ','"""
| parse content, """DATA '_id\":' DQS:id ','"""
| parse content, """DATA 'network' DATA 'dhcp\":' LD:dhcp ','DATA 'dns\":'  DQS:dns ',' DATA 'externalIp\":' DQS:externalIP ',' DATA 'gateway\":' DQS:gateway DATA 'ip\":' DQS:ip DATA 'mask\":' DQS:mask"""
| parse content, """DATA 'model\":' DQS:model ','"""
| parse content, """DATA 'name\":' DQS:name ','"""
| parse content, """DATA 'targetLatency\":' LONG:targetLatency ','"""
// networkJitter
| parse content, """DATA 'networkJitter\":' LONG:networkJitter ','"""
// maxBurstDrop
| parse content, """DATA 'maxBurstDrop\":' LONG:maxBurstDrop ','"""
// manufacturer
| parse content, """DATA 'manufacturer\":' DQS:hwManufacturer ',' DATA 'manufacturer\":' DQS:swManufacturer ','"""

//| parse content, """DATA 'online\":' LD:online ','"""
//| parse content, """DATA 'powerState\":' LONG:powerState ','"""
//| parse content, """DATA 'rebooting\":' LD:rebooting ','"""

// Different ways to parse the log record's message
| parse content, """DATA '@message\":' DQS:message2"""
| parse content, """DATA '\"message\":' DQS:message"""
| parse content, """JSON:j"""
| fieldsAdd message3 = j[`@message`]
| fieldsAdd `Message` = if(isNull(message),if(isNull(message2),message3,else:message2),else:message)
| fieldsAdd `MWEdge Name` = j[`@fields`][`mwedge`][`name`]
| fieldsAdd `MWedge Source` = j[`@fields`][`source`][`name`]
| fieldsAdd `Stream` = j[`@fields`][`stream`][`name`]
| fieldsAdd mwedgeContinuity = j[`@fields`][`values`][`continuityCounter`]
| fieldsAdd mwedgeContinuityExpect = j[`@fields`][`values`][`expected`]
| fieldsAdd channelName = j[`@fields`][`device`][`channel`][`name`]
| fieldsAdd channelNumber = j[`@fields`][`device`][`channel`][`number`]
| fieldsAdd ipAddressExt = j[`@fields`][`device`][`network`][`externalIp`]
| fieldsAdd ipAddressInt = j[`@fields`][`device`][`network`][`ip`]
| expand audioChannels
| fieldsFlatten audioChannels, fields:{audioChannels_id,audioChannels_lang,audioChannels_pid}
| summarize `Count`=count(), by:{`Message`,`Stream`}
| sort `Count` desc
| filterOut isNull(`Stream`)
| fields `Stream`
